resources.string: Isikhathi sidlulile selokhu umkhankaso uye esidlangalaleni kuze kube nguJanuwari 1, 2027.
Ithagethi yokubala wehle ifana nesibhengezo esishicilelwe kokuthi keepandroidopen.org. Uhlelo lokusebenza lubuyekeza kanye ngesekhondi ngenkathi luvuliwe.
I-ANDROID IBA Iplatifomu Ekhiyelwe PHANSI KUYO

I-Android Developer Verification wuhlelo lwe-Google oluxhumanisa lonke uhlelo lokusebenza kumazisi wonjiniyela oqinisekisiwe ngaphambi kokuthi afakwe kumadivayisi e-Android aqinisekisiwe. Onjiniyela kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi bangobani futhi babhalise amagama ephakheji abawashicilelayo. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingenaye unjiniyela obhalisiwe, oqinisekisiwe ngeke zisafakwa ngendlela evamile uma ukuvikela sekukhishiwe.

Ihlala kanzima ekusabalaliseni okuzimele nomthombo ovulekile njenge-F-Droid, ukulanda okuqondile kwe-APK, namaphrojekthi wokuzilibazisa. I-Google ithi imayelana nokuphepha kanye nokumisa i-malware engaziwa. Abagxeki abahlanganisa umkhankaso we-Keep Android Open, i-F-Droid kanye ne-EFF bathi isishintshi sokubulala umlindisango: ukubhaliswa okumaphakathi, i-ID kahulumeni, inkokhelo, kanye nokulawula okugcwele kokuthi idivayisi yakho ivunyelwe ukuthi ithembe ini.

Ukugeleza okuthuthukile kulethwa ngamasevisi e-Google Play, hhayi i-Android OS, ngakho-ke i-Google ingashintsha, ikukhawulele noma iyisuse noma kunini ngaphandle kwesibuyekezo se-OS noma imvume yomsebenzisi. Ukubambezeleka kwamahora angu-24 kuphazamisa ngamabomu futhi kuyisinyathelo esisodwa esimile phakathi kwakho nesofthiwe okhetha ukuyisebenzisa.

string-array.name: timeline_titles
string-array.item: Ikhonsoli yomhlaba wonke, ama-akhawunti anomkhawulo, ukugeleza okuthuthukile

string-array.name: timeline_details
string-array.item: I-Google imemezela ukuthi kusukela ngo-2027, izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Android kufanele zibhaliswe kunjiniyela oqinisekisiwe, okuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakwe ngaphandle kwe-Google Play.

Abasebenzisi bamandla bathola i-hatch yokuphunyuka enzima ngamabomu: nika amandla Izinketho Zonjiniyela, qinisekisa ukuthi awuphoqwa, qalisa kabusha, bese ulinda amahora angu-24 ngaphambi kokuthi uvumele ukufakwa okungaqinisekisiwe.
Isevisi yesistimu engemuva (com.google.android.verifier) ​​iphushwa ngezibuyekezo zesistimu ye-Google ukuya kumadivayisi aqinisekisiwe futhi ihlala ithule kuze kube yilapho isetshenziswa.
I-Google iqinisekisa ukuthi ukusebenza kuqale ngoSepthemba 30, 2026, kuzo zonke izitolo eziyisikhombisa nasemazweni amane.
I-Android Developer ID Status API yethulwa emhlabeni jikelele futhi ukufinyelela kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kuqala ku-Android Developer Console API nama-akhawunti okusabalalisa anomkhawulo.

Ama-akhawunti okusabalalisa anomkhawulo (mahhala, kufikela kumadivayisi angama-20, awekho ama-ID kahulumeni) kanye ne-Console API yethulwa emhlabeni wonke. Ukugeleza okuthuthukisiwe kokulayisha eceleni okungaqinisekisiwe kuqala ukuphuma.

Ukuvikela kuba bukhoma kubasebenzisi base-Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore nase-Thailand kumadivayisi anesitifiketi asebenzisa i-Android 7+. Izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphuma konjiniyela abangaqinisekisiwe zivinjiwe ezitolo ezibamba iqhaza: I-Google Play, i-HONOR App Market, i-OPPO App Market, i-Galaxy Store, i-Palm Store, i-V-Appstore ne-GetApps.
Ukuqinisekisa kunwetshiwe kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza nezifunda. Gcina i-Android Open ibala kuze kube nguJanuwari 1, 2027, lapho i-Android iba inkundla evaliwe.

Umnyango Wezobulungiswa kanye ne-FTC bathatha imibiko yokungathembeki ngamafomu aku-inthanethi. Zisebenzise, ​​bese uthintana nommeleli wakho kanye nezigele ngqo.

• Faka i-F-Droid kumadivayisi akho.
• Phendula inhlolovo yokuqinisekisa kanjiniyela ye-Google.

• Sayina isicelo se-change.org.
• Engeza isibhengezo sokubala wehle kuwebhusayithi yakho.

resources.string: Misa i-Google\'s Android Developer Verification lockdown

%1$s omele othandekayo,

Ngibhala njengomsebenzisi we-Android okhathazekile futhi njengesakhamuzi esisendaweni yakho.

Uhlelo lwe-Google Lokuqinisekisa Unjiniyela we-Android, oluphoqelelwe kusukela ngomhlaka-30 Septhemba 2026 ezimakethe ezimbalwa futhi lwanda emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2027, luzodinga ukuthi lonke uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Android lubhaliswe kunjiniyela oqinisekisiwe ngaphambi kokuthi lufakwe kumadivayisi anesitifiketi. Onjiniyela kufanele bathumele ukuhlonza kukahulumeni, bavumelane nemigomo ye-Google, bakhokhe imali futhi bafake ohlwini zonke izihlonzi zohlelo lokusebenza zamanje nezesikhathi esizayo.

Lokhu akuthuthukisi ukuphepha ngokunenjongo. Inikeza inkampani eyodwa yangasese amandla okunquma ukuthi iyiphi isofthiwe abantu abavunyelwe ukuyisebenzisa kumadivayisi abangawabo, futhi isongela ukusatshalaliswa komthombo ozimele novulekile njenge-F-Droid, engakwazi ukuthobela futhi ingase iphele.

Ngiyakucela ngenhlonipho ukuthi:

1. Phenya ukuthi lolu hlelo aluhambisani nokuncintisana futhi luhlanganisa ukuhlukumeza isikhundla somgcini-sango.
2. Cindezela i-Google ukuze ukhulule umthombo ovulekile nokungasakazwa kokuthengisa, futhi ugcine ukulayisha eceleni kungenakubhaliswa okumaphakathi.
3. Vikela ilungelo labasebenzisi lokusebenzisa isofthiwe abayikhethayo ku-hardware abayithengile.

Ngicela uvume lo mlayezo ngokubhala futhi ungazise ukuthi ihhovisi lakho lithatha siphi isinyathelo.

Futhi ngikopisha umkhankaso we-Keep Android Open ku-%2$s.
